title: Transmitter Days x/60.1?
symptom: The display for 'Transmitter Days' changed from showing a single value to showing something like '33/60.1'. The user expects the transmitter to last at least 90 days and wonders what the '60.1' means.
cause: The thread suggests that the extra values are remnants from switching transmitters, as the user reports that after switching to a different transmitter, xDrip shows '69/69/69.0'.
evidence_quote: Obviously these are remnants from the 81 tx change. After switching to this tx again, xDrip says "69/69/69.0".
